list.title: Consider Your Ways and Build the House
The People Obey and Begin the Work
The Latter Glory of This House
From This Day On I Will Bless You

findings.problem: Passages 1 and 2 form one continuing rebuilding episode: the first passage sets up the problem of the ruined house and gives the command to build, and the second shows the same leaders and people obeying and beginning the work. They should share a story group with consecutive positions rather than both having null story_group and position values.

rule.text: Group passages when the next passage picks up the same story: the same people, and a problem set up in one passage is resolved in a later one.
